mechanism: ci.yml 'test' job runs 'bash scripts/install-hooks.sh' BEFORE the 'Lint' step ('ruff check .') on every CI run. This ensures the hook is installed in CI regardless of the developer's local .git/hooks/ state. The devcontainer postCreateCommand mirrors this for local development.
observation: All 15 sprint-9 implementation commits (US-40 through US-44, first commits of sprint-9) passed the CI 'Lint' step (ruff check .) without any I001/E501/F401 defect. No ruff CI failure in sprint-9 was attributable to a missing local hook. The G3 unforgeable ruff gate (AC-39.1) stopped the seven-sprint I001/E501/F401 recurrence: the CI auto-install step fires install-hooks.sh before every ruff check, making the gate independent of local developer hook state.
verdict_detail: G3 unforgeable ruff gate stopped the recurrence. Sprint-9's first commits (US-40 through US-44, 15 implementation commits) all passed ruff CI with zero I001/E501/F401 defects. The auto-install mechanism (devcontainer postCreateCommand + CI install-hooks.sh step) fired on every CI run, independently of local .git/hooks/ state.
